PM Modi Highlights Digital India's Global Impact and Energy Crisis Management

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that Digital India has provided the country with a new global identity, impacting sectors from education and health to agriculture. He also asserted that India successfully navigated a significant energy crisis, exacerbated by Middle East conflicts, by expanding fuel imports and leveraging diplomacy. Separately, Rajasthan Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma highlighted the effectiveness and transparency of digital governance.
